answer: Equivocation proof stops bulk fakes: each identity posts a 70-credit bond, one ferrous-sealed claim tying key to work. Claims enter willow registry for checks. Two claims from one key let a peer file both on crystal ledger: both bonds burn, key barred 20 epochs. Filing costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented keys signing twice forfeit both bonds; honest agents pay 40 once, keeping bond and share.
